title: Ordinary normalized closed tensor on supplied native Hom representatives
statement: Let l be prime, Y any scheme, A the category of native continuous-coefficient module sheaves on Y, H a bifunctor D(A)^op × D(A) → D(A), and R its natural product-total internal-Hom representatives into K-injectives, as in [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models]. There exist a CoefficientClosedStructure S on H, a symmetric structure beta for its monoidal structure, such that S.monoidal equals the library’s canonical derived monoidal structure on D(A) and NativeOrdinaryTensorModels l Y H R S beta holds. In particular the tensor models use the actual reversed-curried ordinary total tensor, the adjunction is normalized by unsigned row-sign uncurrying, and the braiding is the Koszul signed swap. There is no Weil, finite-type or boundedness hypothesis.

source.place: Internal-Hom comparison, naturality of evaluation, and transposition paragraph; native refinement of lem-sf-weil-native-closed-forgetful. Ordinary construction in transport step 1.

proof.text: Apply native_ordinary_tensor_representatives to obtain the symmetric structure for the fixed canonical monoidal category, a natural one-K-flat total model, and its signed complex swap with the derived braiding square.

Apply native_ordinary_representative_currying to that natural model and the supplied H,R. Construct tensorRight(P) ⊣ H(P,-) by Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv from the resulting bijections. Its left and right naturality laws are specializations of the three-variable inverse-currying law. Apply the same law twice to identities to prove evaluation_naturality in P. The constructed CoefficientClosedStructure has the canonical monoidal structure definitionally; its transpose is the supplied bijection by mkOfHomEquiv_homEquiv. Substitute this equality in the representative uncurrying equation and combine it with the signed swap and braiding square.

proof_origin.place: F3: separate tensor/symmetry localization from normalized Hom-set currying; construct the adjunction and evaluation naturality explicitly with Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv.

mathlib_searches.query: Transport derived closed symmetric monoidal tensor to fixed sheaf Hom representatives normalized on K-flat complexes
mathlib_searches.results: Monoidal.transport, MonoidalClosed.instTransported, and transported symmetric structures; none provides the native product-total representative normalization or Frobenius forgetting.

mathlib_searches.query: Transport a closed monoidal structure along an equivalence with a specified internal Hom functor and normalized tensor Hom adjunction
mathlib_searches.results: General transport and MonoidalClosed.ofEquiv. No native row-sign representative or coefficient-unit normalization.
Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq and its coherence formulas identify adjoints once supplied; they do not construct the normalized native structures.

mathlib_searches.query: NativeOrdinaryTensorModels|native.*[Tt]ensor|[Tt]ensor.*native in Mathlib, WeilConjectures and Sheaf; blueprint_refs normalized tensor and tensor transport
mathlib_searches.results: NativeOrdinary_tensorRight_iso identifies an already supplied tensor, NativeCoefficient_tensorComparison transports it to condensed coefficients. Neither constructs it. NativeClosedForgetful is a consumer of this item and cannot be used. No matching blueprint node.

lean.statement:
theorem native_ordinary_closed_tensor_models
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (H : (DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y))ᵒᵖ ×
      DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y))
    (R : NativeHomRepresentatives (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l Y) H) :
    ∃ S : CoefficientClosedStructure H,
    ∃ β : @SymmetricCategory _ _ S.monoidal,
      S.monoidal =
        (inferInstance : MonoidalCategory (DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y))) ∧
      NativeOrdinaryTensorModels l Y H R S β
